issues.title: Assignment integrity oracle with strict inline prohibitions
issues.body:
## Exclusive mutable scope
- scripts/audit-work-unit-assignments.py
- scripts/tests/test_audit_work_unit_assignments.py

No other files or directories may be modified. Do not modify Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, or any files under crates/.
Only scripts/audit-work-unit-assignments.py and scripts/tests/test_audit_work_unit_assignments.py are authorized.

## Required test matrix
Declared denominator: 1 cases, exactly 1..1.
